task: Allow release-unit successor reevaluation to rebase onto a proven fast-forward main advance only when Git ancestry, successor scope isolation, trusted fresh projection and exact obligation reconciliation all pass; preserve fail-closed behavior for unproven or overlapping main drift.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The bounded multi-release-unit rehearsal successfully merged U01 and then repaired U02 canonical sealing obligation reprojection. After that repair merged to main, the same immutable parent source replay reached U02 successor reevaluation but failed before fresh projection with RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT because the sequence predecessor merged at 12447f0c... while current main had safely advanced to 1d868b19... through Control Plane repair commits. The current runtime requires exact equality between predecessor merge SHA and current main before it can compute the trusted fresh successor projection, so legitimate resumable execution deadlocks whenever main advances after a predecessor merge. The fix must permit only a cryptographically/procedurally proven fast-forward main advance with no successor-scope overlap and then still require the existing trusted fresh projection plus obligation reconciliation.
observableOutcomes: A successor may reevaluate on a newer main only when the predecessor mergedMainSha is an ancestor of current main.
The executor records the exact changed-file set between predecessor merge and current main.
If any changed file overlaps the successor intendedFiles or requiredDependencyFiles, the advance remains blocked as RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT.
If ancestry and non-overlap pass, the runtime carries an explicit trusted main-advance proof into reconciliation.
The pure release-unit runtime accepts a predecessor/main mismatch only when the trusted proof exactly binds fromSha, toSha and relationship=FAST_FORWARD.
Trusted main advance does not itself authorize the unit; the existing trustedFreshProjection and obligation-drift checks must still pass.
Non-fast-forward, missing-proof, forged-proof and scope-overlap cases remain fail closed.
The live U02 rehearsal advances beyond RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT without editing persisted release state or restarting the parent transaction.
unresolvedRisks: Allowing any descendant main without changed-file scope checks could hide concurrent modifications to successor files.
Allowing a boolean bypass without binding exact from/to SHAs could permit forged ancestry claims.
Checking ancestry but not successor dependencies could miss indirect runtime conflicts.
Accepting trusted main advance before fresh projection could bypass authority, gate or dependency drift.
Persisting proof data into the manifest incorrectly could perturb manifest digests or child bindings.

in: Add a narrowly-scoped trusted main-advance proof contract to release-unit reconciliation.
Prove fast-forward ancestry in the GitHub runtime using git merge-base --is-ancestor.
Compute changed files between predecessor merged main and current main and block overlap with successor intendedFiles/requiredDependencyFiles.
Pass the exact proof through reevaluateSuccessorManifest -> prepareActiveUnit -> AUTHORIZE -> reconcileSuccessorReleaseUnit.
Keep reconcileReleaseUnitManifest and predecessorResult fail-closed unless the exact trusted proof matches.
Add positive and adversarial unit/production-surface regressions.
out: No removal of failOnUnrelatedMainDrift semantics for untrusted paths.
No acceptance of non-fast-forward history, force-push ancestry or missing predecessor receipts.
No overlap allowance for intended/dependency files.
No change to release-unit source sealing, materialization, child CI proof, Truth or Lifecycle semantics.
No manual mutation of control-plane/release-state or rehearsal source.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This logic decides whether a successor can execute on a main SHA different from its predecessor merge receipt. A permissive error could execute against unreviewed or conflicting code; an over-strict error breaks resumability. The repair therefore requires exact SHA binding, ancestry proof, changed-file isolation and independent trusted reprojection.

acceptanceCriteria: A trusted main-advance proof has a canonical contract, PASS decision, FAST_FORWARD relationship, fromSha and toSha.
GitHub runtime creates the proof only after git merge-base --is-ancestor(fromSha,toSha) succeeds.
GitHub runtime computes git diff --name-only fromSha..toSha and blocks if any changed file intersects successor intendedFiles or requiredDependencyFiles.
reconcileReleaseUnitManifest accepts predecessor/current mismatch only when trusted proof exactly matches expected predecessor SHA and newBaseSha.
predecessorResult/reconcileSuccessorReleaseUnit accept the same mismatch only with the same exact proof.
trustedFreshProjection remains independently required for reprojectable obligation drift.
Existing test for unrelated main drift without proof still returns RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT.
Forged fromSha/toSha, non-fast-forward ancestry and scope overlap remain blocked.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
After merge, immutable rehearsal replay advances U02 beyond the current main-drift blocker.
invariants: Predecessor merge receipts remain authoritative and immutable.
A main advance proof is valid only for the exact predecessor mergedMainSha -> currentMainSha pair.
Successor intended and required dependency files may not have changed during the accepted main advance.
Fast-forward proof never replaces trusted fresh projection.
Fast-forward proof never replaces material obligation drift checks.
Non-fast-forward or unverifiable ancestry remains fail closed.

failureModes: Exact predecessor/main equality remains hard-coded before fresh projection and replay still deadlocks.
Proof contract can be forged without exact SHA equality.
Ancestry succeeds but overlapping successor files are ignored.
Main advance proof is accepted but trustedFreshProjection=false.
Pure runtime and GitHub runtime disagree about proof semantics.
A non-fast-forward branch relation is misclassified as safe.
edgeCases: predecessor mergedMainSha equals current main exactly
current main is one fast-forward commit ahead with no scope overlap
current main is multiple fast-forward commits ahead with no scope overlap
current main fast-forward changes one intended successor file
current main fast-forward changes one required dependency file
current main is not descendant of predecessor merge
proof fromSha does not equal sequence predecessor receipt
proof toSha does not equal current main
trustedFreshProjection is false despite a valid main-advance proof

alternatives.summary: Bind a fast-forward ancestry + changed-file non-overlap proof to exact predecessor/current SHAs, then still require fresh projection and obligation reconciliation.
alternatives.reason: Preserves exact receipt authority while enabling safe resumability after independent main advances.

alternatives.summary: Remove exact predecessor/current main comparison for successors.
alternatives.reason: Would allow arbitrary concurrent main changes without proof.

alternatives.summary: Discard persisted rehearsal progress and begin the parent release again after every Control Plane fix.
alternatives.reason: Defeats resumability and hides the systemic gap instead of repairing it.

alternatives.summary: Update U01 mergedMainSha to the new main SHA.
alternatives.reason: Would falsify the immutable merge receipt.

specialistReviews.finding: A generic descendant-main exception would weaken the sequential release authority model.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require a typed proof bound to exact SHAs, non-overlap and trusted fresh projection; all unproven cases retain RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT.

specialistReviews.finding: Git history relationship must be independently proven rather than inferred from commit strings.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use git merge-base --is-ancestor in the trusted default-branch executor and carry only the resulting exact proof.

specialistReviews.finding: Predecessor receipts cannot be rewritten to current main just to satisfy the lease.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep receipts immutable and represent current-main advancement as a separate proof object.

specialistReviews.finding: U01 is already merged and U02 is blocked only because Control Plane fixes advanced main after that merge.
specialistReviews.resolution: Permit safe reprojection only after exact ancestry/scope proof, then require the existing successor projection and obligation gates.

specialistReviews.finding: The live rehearsal exposed an untested interaction between sequential merge receipts and Control Plane self-repair during a resumable parent execution.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add direct unit and production-surface regressions for both accepted and rejected main-advance paths.

challenge.scenario: Current main equals predecessor merge SHA.
Current main is a fast-forward descendant and changed files do not overlap successor scope.
challenge.finding: Current code blocks before trusted projection can run.
challenge.resolution: Create exact trusted main-advance proof and allow reevaluation to proceed.

challenge.scenario: Fast-forward changes an intended successor file.
challenge.finding: Fresh projection alone should not silently normalize concurrent edits.
challenge.resolution: Block the main advance before reprojection with RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT details including overlap.

challenge.scenario: Fast-forward changes a required dependency file.
challenge.resolution: Treat dependency overlap the same as intended-file overlap and block.

challenge.scenario: The predecessor merge receipt points to commit A, current main is commit B, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor A B` returns non-zero because history diverged or was rewritten.
challenge.finding: Without a proven ancestor relationship, B cannot be treated as a continuation of the predecessor merge; accepting it would detach successor authorization from the immutable merge receipt.
challenge.resolution: Return RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT before candidate materialization, emit no trusted main-advance proof, and require a new canonical release path rather than normalizing divergent history.

challenge.scenario: A proof object names the wrong predecessor SHA.
challenge.finding: Could detach authorization from the actual receipt.
challenge.resolution: Pure runtime must exact-match proof.fromSha to sequence.merge.mergedMainSha.

challenge.scenario: Proof names a different toSha from current main.
Valid ancestry proof exists but trustedFreshProjection=false.
challenge.finding: Safe history relationship does not prove current obligations.
challenge.resolution: Obligation reprojection remains blocked unless trustedFreshProjection=true.

challenge.scenario: Main advances only through Control Plane files as in the live rehearsal.
challenge.resolution: Ancestry + non-overlap proof allows U02 fresh projection against current main.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only on the fresh branch from main 1d868b19a8517142a435c649c3adacb79d804d96 and require Plan Before Code PASS before runtime edits.
Modify the pure release-unit runtime to validate an explicit trusted main-advance proof rather than a boolean bypass.
Modify the GitHub runtime to prove ancestry and changed-file non-overlap before calling successor reconciliation.
Add unit regressions preserving the existing no-proof RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT case and covering exact-proof acceptance/forgery rejection.
Add production-surface regressions for git ancestry and scope-overlap proof construction.
Require full exact-head Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Incremental/Release Risk/Quality/TypeScript/Build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle proof.
Merge only after exact PR-head success.

Replay immutable source release-execution/source/control-plane-multi-unit-rehearsal-v1 at SHA 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 and verify U02 advances beyond RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT without release-state edits.

requirements.requirement: Successor execution may reconcile onto a newer main only through an exact trusted fast-forward ancestry and scope-isolation proof, followed by the existing trusted fresh projection and obligation checks.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A successor may not accept predecessor/current main mismatch without an exact trusted proof.
A main advance touching successor intended or required dependency files may not be accepted.
A non-fast-forward or unverifiable main relationship may not be accepted.
